text: Activia is a fermented milk made with the two yoghurt starters plus Danone's own Bifidobacterium strain DN-173 010, which Danone developed to survive the acidity of yoghurt. Some markets' labels also list Lactococcus lactis; the trial paper names only the two starters and the bifidobacterium, so it is left out of the table. Fermentation temperature and time are not published.
